Priyom —

Appreciate the fast escalation and the context. I approve a one-year, 25% concession on Hosted API usage for CrimsonBridge under the following firm conditions:

1) Contract must include a 12-month minimum commitment (no early termination without accelerated payment).
2) Payment terms: net-30 with a 25% upfront deposit OR prepay quarterly invoicing. No monthly-only net-60.

5) This approval is contingent on CS-led onboarding plan that ensures caching/batching configuration to keep unit cost within modeled thresholds.

Marcus — please confirm runway for capacity (burst + reserved GPU pools) and that operations approves the proposed onboard schedule. If ok, Priyom, you have my sign-off to present a 25% net concession and proceed to DocuSign.
